versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-sls-data-agent-qa skill.

- Enables querying and analysis of real business data via SLS Context Models.
- Supports guiding users to select models, resolve endpoints, and clarify analysis objectives.
- Provides workflows for model exploration, term clarification, schema lookup, and query location resolution.
- Allows systematic evidence gathering through answer branches, based on verified business definitions and example queries.
- Not intended for inspecting or managing models; focused on answering business questions using model data.
